resources.string: Lets Autotapper dispatch taps into the game. Nothing is read from the screen through this service and nothing leaves the device.

Toggle greyed out, or “Controlled by Restricted Setting”? That is Android blocking Accessibility for sideloaded apps, not a fault in this app. Samsung: turn off Settings → Security and privacy → Auto Blocker first. Then in App info use ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”. Failing that, over ADB: adb shell appops set dev.autotapper ACCESS_RESTRICTED_SETTINGS allow
